AdminRegistryEntry.title: AdminRegistryEntry
AdminRegistryEntry.description: Single source of truth for administrative authorization (D1). Keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Both Backend and Firestore Security Rules verify uid, role == 'admin', and active == true.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

active.description: Whether administrative privileges are currently active.

grantedByUid.description: UID of the administrator who granted this entry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

AdminBootstrapLock.title: AdminBootstrapLock
AdminBootstrapLock.description: Immutable one-time lock document created atomically with the first Bootstrap Admin document to permanently close the Bootstrap flow.

initialized.description: Always true once bootstrap initialization has completed.

bootstrapAdminUid.description: Firebase UID of the initial bootstrap administrator.

bootstrapAdminEmail.description: Verified email of the initial bootstrap administrator.

AdminSecurityConfig.title: AdminSecurityConfig
AdminSecurityConfig.description: Admin-only system configuration document reserved for upcoming milestones (M1.2+).

description.description: Human-readable description of this configuration record.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the verified administrator who last modified this document.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Single source of truth for Admin RBAC (D1). Strictly deny-by-default; non-admins can only GET their own UID path for verification and can never write or list.

/adminSystem/bootstrap.description: Immutable one-time lock document created atomically with the first Bootstrap Admin entry. Permanently seals Bootstrap after initialization.

/adminConfig/{configId}.description: Protected administrative configuration namespace reserved for M1.2+.
